subject: Exclusive Summer Sale - Limited Time Offer!
body: Dear valued customer, Get ready for our exclusive summer sale! For a limited time only, enjoy up to 50% off on selected items. From trendy summer dresses to stylish swimwear, we have everything you need to stay fashionable this season. Don't miss out on this opportunity to upgrade your summer wardrobe at unbeatable prices. Visit our store or shop online to discover the hottest deals before they're gone! Happy shopping!
